instruction: The italic text is hard to see. Current font size is 12 and I want to change the font size of all italicized words to 16 to make them more visible. Can you help me with this?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing font size of all italic text from 12pt to 16pt. Evaluator checks if all 21 italic runs have font size 16. Verified document has 21 italic runs currently at 12pt that need resizing to 16pt.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly identifies all italic runs using run.italic property
Font size verification logic is correct: checks run.font.size.pt == 16 for all italic text
Complete coverage: verifies ALL italic text in the document, matching the instruction requirement
Postconfig correctly saves document with Ctrl+S before evaluation to ensure file state is fresh
Proper all-or-nothing logic: returns 1.0 only if ALL italic text is 16pt, otherwise 0.0
Edge case handling: correctly returns 0.0 if no italic text found

Minor issue: If an italic run has font.size=None, it would cause the metric to fail even though the run might not have an explicit size set (inherits from style). However, this is unlikely in practice since LibreOffice explicitly sets font sizes.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding explicit handling for runs where font.size is None - either count them as pass/fail based on the paragraph's style, or log a warning. However, this is a minor edge case unlikely to occur in typical documents.
